query.statement: SELECT PLAN_ID, PLAN_NAME, PLANT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PLANNED_QTY, PLANNED_START_DATE, PLANNED_END_DATE, STATUS, REMARK FROM POM_PRODUCTION_PLAN WHERE PLANT_ID = @plantId AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY PLANNED_START_DATE
SELECT STATUS, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM POM_PRODUCTION_PLAN WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) GROUP BY STATUS ORDER BY STATUS

SELECT ORDER_ID, PLAN_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, ORDER_QTY, ACTUAL_QTY, SCHEDULED_START, SCHEDULED_END, ACTUAL_START, ACTUAL_END, STATUS FROM POM_PRODUCTION_ORDER WHERE PLAN_ID = @planId AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY SCHEDULED_START

SELECT ORDER_ID, PLAN_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, ORDER_QTY, ACTUAL_QTY, SCHEDULED_START, SCHEDULED_END, ACTUAL_START, ACTUAL_END, STATUS FROM POM_PRODUCTION_ORDER WHERE EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY SCHEDULED_START DESC

SELECT LOT_ID, PLANT_ID, WORK_ORDER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, QTY, DEFECT_QTY, LOT_STATE, PROCESS_STATE, ROUTE_STEPS, CURRENT_STEP, EQUIPMENT_ID, RECIPE_DEF_ID, RECIPE_DEF_VERSION, CARRIER_ID, IS_HOLD FROM POM_LOT WHERE PLANT_ID = @plantId AND (@lotState IS NULL OR LOT_STATE = @lotState) ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT LOT_ID, PLANT_ID, WORK_ORDER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, QTY, DEFECT_QTY, LOT_STATE, PROCESS_STATE, ROUTE_STEPS, CURRENT_STEP, EQUIPMENT_ID, RECIPE_DEF_ID, RECIPE_DEF_VERSION, CARRIER_ID, IS_HOLD FROM POM_LOT WHERE WORK_ORDER_ID = @workOrderId ORDER BY LOT_ID

SELECT LOT_HISTORY_ID, PLANT_ID, LOT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, PROCESS_ID, RECIPE_DEF_ID, RECIPE_DEF_VERSION, TRACK_IN_TIME, TRACK_OUT_TIME, EXECUTION_ID, EXECUTION_USER, QTY, DEFECT_QTY, LOT_STATE, PROCESS_STATE, CREATED_AT FROM POM_LOT_HISTORY WHERE PLANT_ID = @plantId AND LOT_ID = @lotId ORDER BY LOT_HISTORY_ID

SELECT ORDER_ID, PLAN_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, ORDER_QTY, ACTUAL_QTY, SCHEDULED_START, SCHEDULED_END, ACTUAL_START, ACTUAL_END, STATUS FROM POM_PRODUCTION_ORDER WHERE (@planId IS NULL OR PLAN_ID = @planId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY SCHEDULED_START DESC

SELECT LOT_ID, PLANT_ID, WORK_ORDER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, QTY, DEFECT_QTY, LOT_STATE, PROCESS_STATE, ROUTE_STEPS, CURRENT_STEP, EQUIPMENT_ID, CARRIER_ID, IS_HOLD, VERSION_NO, CONTROL_MODE, RETURN_STEP FROM POM_LOT WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@lotState IS NULL OR LOT_STATE = @lotState) AND (@isHold IS NULL OR IS_HOLD = @isHold) ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT LOT_ID, PLANT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, QTY, LOT_STATE, PROCESS_STATE, EQUIPMENT_ID, IS_HOLD FROM POM_LOT WHERE IS_HOLD = 'Y' ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT LOT_ID, PLANT_ID, PRODUCT_ID, QTY, DEFECT_QTY, LOT_STATE, EQUIPMENT_ID FROM POM_LOT WHERE DEFECT_QTY > 0 ORDER BY DEFECT_QTY DESC
SELECT PRODUCT_ID, COUNT(*) AS LOT_COUNT, SUM(QTY) AS TOTAL_QTY, SUM(DEFECT_QTY) AS DEFECT_QTY, SUM(QTY) - SUM(DEFECT_QTY) AS GOOD_QTY FROM POM_LOT GROUP BY PRODUCT_ID ORDER BY TOTAL_QTY DESC

SELECT WORK_ORDER_ID, PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID, PLANT_ID, WORK_ORDER_NAME, PRODUCT_ID, ROUTING_SCOPE, ROUTING_ID, ROUTING_STEP_NO, PROCESS_ID, WORK_CENTER_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, WORK_ORDER_TYPE, OWNER_ID, PLAN_START_DATE, PLAN_END_DATE, PLAN_QTY, START_QTY, COMPLETE_QTY, SCRAP_QTY, STATUS, IS_HOLD, STARTED_AT, COMPLETED_AT, DESCRIPTION, VERSION_NO FROM POM_WORK_ORDER WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@workOrderId IS NULL OR WORK_ORDER_ID = @workOrderId) AND (@productionOrderId IS NULL OR PRODUCTION_ORDER_ID = @productionOrderId) AND (@routingScope IS NULL OR ROUTING_SCOPE = @routingScope) AND (@processId IS NULL OR PROCESS_ID = @processId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@ownerId IS NULL OR OWNER_ID = @ownerId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY PLAN_START_DATE DESC, WORK_ORDER_ID

SELECT EXECUTION_ID, WORK_ORDER_ID, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, ACTION, FROM_STATUS, TO_STATUS, GOOD_QTY, DEFECT_QTY, USER_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, CLIENT_CHANNEL, DEVICE_ID, OCCURRED_AT, REMARK FROM POM_WORK_ORDER_EXECUTION WHERE (@workOrderId IS NULL OR WORK_ORDER_ID = @workOrderId) AND (@action IS NULL OR ACTION = @action) ORDER BY OCCURRED_AT DESC, EXECUTION_ID DESC

WITH RECURSIVE ROUTE_PARTS (LOT_ID, STEP_INDEX, PROCESS_ID, REST) AS ( SELECT LOT_ID, 0, CASE WHEN INSTR(ROUTE_STEPS, '>') = 0 THEN ROUTE_STEPS ELSE SUBSTR(ROUTE_STEPS, 1, INSTR(ROUTE_STEPS, '>') - 1) END, CASE WHEN INSTR(ROUTE_STEPS, '>') = 0 THEN '' ELSE SUBSTR(ROUTE_STEPS, INSTR(ROUTE_STEPS, '>') + 1) END FROM POM_LOT UNION ALL SELECT LOT_ID, STEP_INDEX + 1, CASE WHEN INSTR(REST, '>') = 0 THEN REST ELSE SUBSTR(REST, 1, INSTR(REST, '>') - 1) END, CASE WHEN INSTR(REST, '>') = 0 THEN '' ELSE SUBSTR(REST, INSTR(REST, '>') + 1) END FROM ROUTE_PARTS WHERE REST <> '' ) SELECT L.LOT_ID, L.PLANT_ID, L.WORK_ORDER_ID, L.PRODUCT_ID, L.QTY, L.DEFECT_QTY, L.LOT_STATE, L.PROCESS_STATE, L.ROUTE_STEPS, L.CURRENT_STEP, CURRENT_ROUTE.PROCESS_ID AS CURRENT_PROCESS_ID, CASE WHEN NEXT_ROUTE.PROCESS_ID IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(L.RETURN_STEP, L.CURRENT_STEP + 1) END AS NEXT_STEP, NEXT_ROUTE.PROCESS_ID AS NEXT_PROCESS_ID, L.RETURN_STEP, RETURN_ROUTE.PROCESS_ID AS RETURN_PROCESS_ID, CASE WHEN L.RETURN_STEP IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS IS_IN_REWORK, L.EQUIPMENT_ID, L.RECIPE_DEF_ID, L.RECIPE_DEF_VERSION, L.CARRIER_ID, L.IS_HOLD, L.VERSION_NO, L.CONTROL_MODE FROM POM_LOT L LEFT JOIN ROUTE_PARTS CURRENT_ROUTE ON CURRENT_ROUTE.LOT_ID = L.LOT_ID AND CURRENT_ROUTE.STEP_INDEX = L.CURRENT_STEP LEFT JOIN ROUTE_PARTS NEXT_ROUTE ON NEXT_ROUTE.LOT_ID = L.LOT_ID AND NEXT_ROUTE.STEP_INDEX = COALESCE(L.RETURN_STEP, L.CURRENT_STEP + 1) LEFT JOIN ROUTE_PARTS RETURN_ROUTE ON RETURN_ROUTE.LOT_ID = L.LOT_ID AND RETURN_ROUTE.STEP_INDEX = L.RETURN_STEP WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR L.PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@lotId IS NULL OR L.LOT_ID = @lotId) AND (@controlMode IS NULL OR L.CONTROL_MODE = @controlMode) ORDER BY L.UPDATED_AT DESC, L.CREATED_AT DESC, L.LOT_ID

SELECT EXCEPTION_ID, LOT_ID, PLANT_ID, DEVIATION_TYPE, FROM_STEP, TO_STEP, TO_STEP AS TARGET_STEP_INDEX, FROM_PROCESS_ID, TO_PROCESS_ID, BOUND_LOT_VERSION, BOUND_LOT_VERSION AS VERSION_NO, REASON, CASE WHEN STATUS IN ('Requested', 'Approved') AND datetime(EXPIRES_AT) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'Expired' ELSE STATUS END AS STATUS, REQUESTED_BY, REQUESTED_AT, EXPIRES_AT, REVIEWED_BY, REVIEWED_AT, REVIEW_REASON, REVIEW_CLIENT_CHANNEL, REVIEW_DEVICE_ID, APPLIED_BY, APPLIED_AT, APPLIED_EXECUTION_ID, CLIENT_CHANNEL, DEVICE_ID FROM POM_ROUTE_EXCEPTION WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@lotId IS NULL OR LOT_ID = @lotId) AND (@deviationType IS NULL OR DEVIATION_TYPE = @deviationType) AND (@exceptionStatus IS NULL OR CASE WHEN STATUS IN ('Requested', 'Approved') AND datetime(EXPIRES_AT) <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'Expired' ELSE STATUS END = @exceptionStatus) ORDER BY REQUESTED_AT DESC, EXCEPTION_ID DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT EXECUTION_ID, LOT_ID, ACTION, ROUTE_EXCEPTION_ID, FROM_STEP, TO_STEP, FROM_PROCESS_ID, TO_PROCESS_ID, CONTROL_MODE, CLIENT_CHANNEL, DEVICE_ID, REASON, EXPECTED_VERSION, RESULT_VERSION, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT FROM ( SELECT E.EXECUTION_ID, E.LOT_ID, L.PLANT_ID, E.ACTION, E.ROUTE_EXCEPTION_ID, E.FROM_STEP, E.TO_STEP, E.FROM_PROCESS_ID, E.TO_PROCESS_ID, E.CONTROL_MODE, E.CLIENT_CHANNEL, E.DEVICE_ID, E.REASON, E.EXPECTED_VERSION, E.RESULT_VERSION, E.CREATED_BY, E.CREATED_AT FROM POM_LOT_EXECUTION E INNER JOIN POM_LOT L ON L.LOT_ID = E.LOT_ID WHERE E.ACTION IN ('RoutingModeChange', 'Bypass', 'Alternative', 'SequenceChange', 'Rework', 'Return') UNION ALL -- 재작업 완료 후 자동 복귀는 LOT 상태 이력에 기록되므로 같은 타임라인으로 투영한다. SELECT 'HIST-' || CAST(H.LOT_HISTORY_ID AS TEXT), H.LOT_ID, H.PLANT_ID, 'Return', NULL, RETURN_EXECUTION.FROM_STEP, RETURN_EXECUTION.TO_STEP, RETURN_EXECUTION.FROM_PROCESS_ID, RETURN_EXECUTION.TO_PROCESS_ID, RETURN_EXECUTION.CONTROL_MODE, RETURN_EXECUTION.CLIENT_CHANNEL, RETURN_EXECUTION.DEVICE_ID, H.REASON, RETURN_EXECUTION.EXPECTED_VERSION, RETURN_EXECUTION.RESULT_VERSION, COALESCE(RETURN_EXECUTION.CREATED_BY, H.EXECUTION_USER), H.CREATED_AT FROM POM_LOT_HISTORY H LEFT JOIN POM_LOT_EXECUTION RETURN_EXECUTION ON RETURN_EXECUTION.LOT_ID = H.LOT_ID AND RETURN_EXECUTION.EXECUTION_ID = H.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY AND RETURN_EXECUTION.ACTION = 'TrackOut' WHERE H.EXECUTION_ID = 'Return' ) TIMELINE WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@lotId IS NULL OR LOT_ID = @lotId) AND (@deviationType IS NULL OR ACTION = @deviationType) ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, EXECUTION_ID DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT EXECUTION_ID, LOT_ID, PLANT_ID, PROCESS_ID, DEFECT_CODE, DEFECT_QTY, EXECUTION_USER, CLIENT_CHANNEL, DEVICE_ID, OCCURRED_AT, CREATED_AT FROM POM_LOT_DEFECT_EXECUTION WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@lotId IS NULL OR LOT_ID = @lotId) AND (@processId IS NULL OR PROCESS_ID = @processId) AND (@defectCode IS NULL OR DEFECT_CODE = @defectCode) ORDER BY OCCURRED_AT DESC, EXECUTION_ID DESC, DEFECT_CODE LIMIT 500

SELECT LOT_HISTORY_ID, PLANT_ID, LOT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, PROCESS_ID, TRACK_IN_TIME, TRACK_OUT_TIME, EXECUTION_ID, EXECUTION_USER, QTY, DEFECT_QTY, LOT_STATE, PROCESS_STATE, REASON, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY FROM POM_LOT_HISTORY WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@lotId IS NULL OR LOT_ID = @lotId) ORDER BY LOT_HISTORY_ID DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT P.PLANNED_ORDER_ID, P.RUN_ID, P.ITEM_ID, P.ORDER_TYPE, P.GROSS_QTY, P.ON_HAND_QTY, P.ON_ORDER_QTY, P.SAFETY_STOCK_QTY, P.NET_QTY, P.SUGGESTED_QTY, P.DUE_DATE, P.RELEASE_DATE, P.SOURCE_DEMAND, P.STATUS, P.PLANT_ID, P.CONVERTED_ORDER_ID FROM MRP_PLANNED_ORDER P INNER JOIN MRP_RUN SR ON SR.RUN_ID = P.RUN_ID AND SR.STATUS = 'Success' WHERE P.RUN_ID = COALESCE(@runId, (SELECT R.RUN_ID FROM MRP_RUN R WHERE R.STATUS = 'Success' ORDER BY R.STARTED_AT DESC, R.RUN_ID DESC LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY P.ORDER_TYPE, P.RELEASE_DATE, P.ITEM_ID

SELECT G.PLANNED_ORDER_ID, G.ITEM_ID, G.DEMAND_REF, G.QTY FROM MRP_PEGGING G INNER JOIN MRP_RUN SR ON SR.RUN_ID = G.RUN_ID AND SR.STATUS = 'Success' WHERE G.RUN_ID = COALESCE(@runId, (SELECT R.RUN_ID FROM MRP_RUN R WHERE R.STATUS = 'Success' ORDER BY R.STARTED_AT DESC, R.RUN_ID DESC LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY G.PLANNED_ORDER_ID, G.PEGGING_ID LIMIT 500

SELECT W.WORK_CENTER_ID, W.WORK_CENTER_NAME, W.DAILY_CAPACITY_MIN, COALESCE(SUM(P.SUGGESTED_QTY * S.STD_TIME_MIN), 0) AS LOAD_MIN, CASE WHEN W.DAILY_CAPACITY_MIN > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(P.SUGGESTED_QTY * S.STD_TIME_MIN), 0) * 1.0 / W.DAILY_CAPACITY_MIN, 2) ELSE NULL END AS REQUIRED_DAYS FROM MDM_WORK_CENTER W LEFT JOIN MDM_ROUTING_STEP S ON S.WORK_CENTER_ID = W.WORK_CENTER_ID LEFT JOIN MDM_ROUTING R ON R.ROUTING_ID = S.ROUTING_ID LEFT JOIN MRP_PLANNED_ORDER P ON P.ITEM_ID = R.PRODUCT_ID AND P.ORDER_TYPE = 'Production' AND P.STATUS IN ('Proposed', 'Converted') AND P.RUN_ID = COALESCE(@runId, (SELECT R2.RUN_ID FROM MRP_RUN R2 WHERE R2.STATUS = 'Success' ORDER BY R2.STARTED_AT DESC, R2.RUN_ID DESC LIMIT 1)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MRP_RUN SR WHERE SR.RUN_ID = P.RUN_ID AND SR.STATUS = 'Success') WHERE W.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' GROUP BY W.WORK_CENTER_ID, W.WORK_CENTER_NAME, W.DAILY_CAPACITY_MIN ORDER BY LOAD_MIN DESC
SELECT RUN_ID, STARTED_AT, FINISHED_AT, STATUS, DEMAND_COUNT, PLANNED_ORDER_COUNT, MESSAGE, EXECUTED_BY FROM MRP_RUN ORDER BY STARTED_AT DESC

SELECT DISPOSITION_ID, PLANT_ID, LOT_ID, WORK_ORDER_ID, PROCESS_ID, DEFECT_EXECUTION_ID, DEFECT_CODE, DISPOSITION_TYPE, QUANTITY, REASON_CODE, REASON, DECIDED_BY, APPROVED_BY, DECIDED_AT, SOURCE_EXECUTION_ID, CLIENT_CHANNEL, DEVICE_ID FROM POM_LOT_DISPOSITION WHERE PLANT_ID = @plantId AND (@lotId IS NULL OR LOT_ID = @lotId) AND (@workOrderId IS NULL OR WORK_ORDER_ID = @workOrderId) AND (@dispositionType IS NULL OR DISPOSITION_TYPE = @dispositionType) AND (@from IS NULL OR DECIDED_AT >= @from) AND (@to IS NULL OR DECIDED_AT < @to) ORDER BY DECIDED_AT DESC, DISPOSITION_ID DESC LIMIT 500
